position_overview: The Social Media Manager will lead our digital presence and brand engagement initiatives. This role is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive social media strategy that increases brand awareness, drives audience engagement, and supports revenue growth. The ideal candidate is both creative and analytical, with strong platform expertise and a passion for building online communities.
qualifications:
is both creative and analytical, with strong platform expertise and a passion for building online communities.

 KEY RESPONSIBLITIES 

Strategy & Planning

Design and implement a comprehensive social media strategy aligned with overall business and marketing objectives.

Develop and manage detailed content calendars to ensure consistent, timely, and strategic messaging.

Align social campaigns with product launches, promotions, and company initiatives.

Content Creation & Curation

Create, edit, and publish daily high-quality content (text, images, short-form and long-form video) tailored to platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Maintain brand voice, tone, and visual consistency across all channels.

Collaborate with internal and external creative resources to produce compelling multimedia content.

Community Management

Monitor, respond to, and engage with followers, comments, and direct messages in a timely and professional manner.

Foster community growth and brand loyalty through proactive engagement strategies.

Manage brand reputation and escalate customer concerns when appropriate.

Analytics & Reporting

Track, analyze, and report on key performance indicators including engagement rates, audience growth, conversions, and ROI.

Translate performance data into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

Conduct A/B testing and optimize campaigns based on performance metrics.

Paid Social Media Management

Plan, execute, and optimize paid social advertising campaigns to increase reach, engagement, and conversions.

Manage advertising budgets and monitor cost-efficiency metrics.

Partner with leadership to evaluate return on investment and campaign effectiveness.
